title: Amazing
body: Amazing, very simple to use, clear and absolutely no fluff! I can easily add my health habits and track my progress throughout the week. Super easy to send screenshots of main grid to friends for accountability! A win for me!
author: Fashionably Late285

title: exactly what i needed
body: this app has the exact kind of layout i was looking for in a daily habit tracker! apart from having to pay for a membership to list more than 2 habits, i say it’s worth it! the interface is so easy + i love that you’re able to pick your own colour down to the specific code. it really tickles the brain seeing my daily habits ticked off in 1 calendar
author: yupppppp!!!!!11!1!1

title: Great habit app, easy to use
body:
Really great app. Simple but with all the features you need. It’s keeping me motivated so I’m really pleased with it. 

I love the haptic feedback and little trophy when I have a streak going.
author: 784BLUE784
